# Objective Assertion Engineering: Technical Specification

> Engineering deterministic, machine-verifiable evaluation assertions. Replaces subjective human or LLM "vibes" with structural, schema, regex, negative boundary, and count reconciliation checks.

## Canonical Docs

- [Evaluating Skills](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills.md): Designing quantitative evaluations and reproducible assertions.
- [Specification](https://agentskills.io/specification.md): Standardizing file structures and expected artifacts.
- [Best Practices](https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/best-practices.md): Verifiable output constraints and failure modes.

## Architecture & Concepts

- [Assertion Taxonomy](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt#assertion-taxonomy): The 5 classes of deterministic assertions (Structural, Schema, Deterministic Content, Negative Bounding, Reconciling Counts).
- [Eliminating Vibes](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt#eliminating-vibes): Translating subjective quality descriptions into binary automated graders.
- [Negative Bounding Assertions](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt#negative-bounding-assertions): Explicitly asserting the absence of hallucinations, banned phrases, and unrequested side-effects.
- [Count Reconciliation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt#count-reconciliation): Programmatic parity checks between summary metadata and rendered artifact bodies.
- [Assertion Implementation](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/objective-assertion-engineering/llms-full.txt#assertion-implementation): Writing resilient regex, JSON schemas, and Python AST validators.
